senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Shittim, a ravine opposite Jericho.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:12">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 25:1">Num. XXV, 1</cite>) <he>ש׳ שמה</he> the name of the place was Sh., v. <cite ref="U00739"><he>שְׁטוּת</he></cite>.

Gen. R. s. 18 (ref. to Mal. II, 13 שנית) שניה לש׳ the second time (you did this) since the events at Shittim (Num. l. c.). Tanḥ. T’rum. 9 חטאו בש׳ ולקו בש׳ ונתרפאו בשִׁטִּים they sinned at Sh. (Num. l. c.), they were smitten at Sh. (ib. 9), and were healed through shiṭṭim (acacias, of the Tabernacle); a. e.
